title: QR fuel system introduced to avoid shortages: President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake yesterday said the reintroduction of the QR code fuel distribution system is a necessary step to manage limited energy supplies caused by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, while assuring that the Government has taken extensive measures to prevent shortages of fuel, gas and coal in the country.

title: Sri Lanka Tourism ensures seamless travel with priority fuel and LPG access
byline: Fearing a possible fuel shortage stemming from the ongoing Middle East conflict, the government has introduced a national fuel quota for vehicles.

title: International kingpin ’’Paravi Suda’’ linked to recent heroin haul
byline: Investigations into the recent seizure of over 123kg of heroin in international waters south of Sri Lanka have uncovered a direct link to the notorious overseas-based drug trafficker and organised criminal, ’’Paravi Suda.’’

title: Economic activity holds in February; Iran war begins to weigh on outlook
byline: Sri Lanka’s economic activities were seen holding up in February before the war broke out at the end of the month, as seen from the Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data, but the economy is currently feeling the brunt of the Iran war which broke out at the end of February.
